methodologyNotes: Published self-serve consumer VPN pricing was collected on the accessed date from each provider's own pricing page where it returned usable USD figures, and from dedicated 2026 pricing-review pages (primarily Security.org, corroborated by Cybernews/Tom's Guide aggregates) where the official page returned a 403/503 or geolocated to EUR. All prices are flat per-account per month in USD; consumer VPN accounts bundle a fixed number of simultaneous device connections (noted per tier) rather than charging per seat, so billingModel is flat throughout. Where a provider offers term-based pricing the lowest published rate (typically the 2-year term) is taken as monthlyUsd with the monthly/1-year rates and any bonus months recorded in notes; annualDiscountPct is left null because the headline rate is itself the multi-year promotional price. HIPAA/BAA are not applicable to consumer VPN service and are recorded null; minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every tier.

vendors.name: NordVPN
vendors.provenance: Official nordvpn.com/pricing returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so 2026 USD per-tier pricing was taken from Security.org's NordVPN pricing page (accessed 2026-06-13) and corroborated against the Security.org best-VPN roundup and a 2026 NordVPN pricing search aggregate.

plans.name: Basic (2-year)
plans.notes: Full VPN access with basic Threat Protection (ad and malicious-domain blocking), up to 10 simultaneous device connections, 30-day money-back guarantee. Lowest rate is the 2-year term; 1-year is $4.99/mo and 1-month is $12.99/mo.

plans.name: Plus (2-year)
plans.notes: Everything in Basic plus Threat Protection Pro and NordPass Premium password manager; up to 10 devices. 1-year is $5.49/mo and 1-month is $15.29/mo.

plans.name: Complete (2-year)
plans.notes: Everything in Plus plus 1TB of NordLocker encrypted cloud storage; up to 10 devices. 1-year is $6.99/mo and 1-month is $18.69/mo.

plans.name: Prime (2-year)
plans.notes: Everything in Complete plus Coveron identity-theft protection with up to $1M recovery coverage; up to 10 devices. 1-year is $8.99/mo and 1-month is $25.29/mo.

vendors.name: ExpressVPN
vendors.provenance: Official expressvpn.com/order returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so 2026 USD per-tier pricing was taken from Security.org's ExpressVPN pricing page (accessed 2026-06-13). A separate 2026 search aggregate showed slightly higher 2-year rates ($3.49/$4.49/$7.49) reflecting a non-promotional snapshot; the Security.org fetched figures are used as primary.

plans.name: Basic (2-year)
plans.notes: Core VPN: 3,000+ servers in 105 countries, Lightway protocol, Network Lock kill switch, split tunneling, up to 10 devices, 30-day money-back guarantee. 2-year term includes 4 bonus months; 1-year is $4.99/mo (3 bonus months) and 1-month is $12.99/mo.

plans.name: Advanced (2-year)
plans.notes: Everything in Basic plus ExpressVPN Keys password manager and Aircove router discounts; up to 12 devices. 1-year is $5.99/mo and 1-month is $13.99/mo.

plans.name: Pro (2-year)
plans.notes: Everything in Advanced plus an identity-protection service; up to 14 devices. 1-year is $8.99/mo and 1-month is $19.99/mo.

vendors.name: Surfshark
vendors.provenance: Official surfshark.com/pricing rendered without USD figures under WebFetch (prices vary by detected currency/VAT), so 2026 USD per-tier pricing was confirmed against Security.org's Surfshark pricing page (accessed 2026-06-13); 1-month rates match the official tier structure (unlimited devices, 30-day guarantee).

plans.name: Starter (24-month)
plans.notes: VPN-only tier with unlimited simultaneous device connections, ad blocker, and 30-day money-back guarantee. 24-month introductory rate; 1-month is $15.45/mo; renews at $79/yr.

plans.name: One (24-month)
plans.notes: VPN plus Surfshark Antivirus, Alternative ID, and breach/data-leak monitoring (Alert); unlimited devices. 1-month is $17.95/mo; renews at $99/yr.

plans.name: One+ (24-month)
plans.notes: Everything in One plus Incogni personal-data-removal service; unlimited devices. 1-month is $20.85/mo; renews at $119/yr.

vendors.name: Proton VPN
vendors.provenance: Official protonvpn.com/pricing rendered pricing placeholders ($0.00) under WebFetch, so paid-tier USD pricing was confirmed against Security.org's Proton VPN pricing page (accessed 2026-06-13); the Free tier and per-tier device limits (Free 1 device, paid 10 devices) were confirmed directly from the fetched protonvpn.com pricing page.

plans.name: Proton Free
plans.notes: Free forever: 1 device at a time, unlimited bandwidth, no logs and no ads; streaming and torrenting not supported on the free tier.

plans.name: VPN Plus (2-year)

plans.name: Proton Unlimited (2-year)
plans.notes: All VPN Plus features plus premium Proton Pass, Mail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, and Sheets; up to 10 VPN devices. 2-year term $191.76 total; 1-year is $9.99/mo ($119.88/yr) and 1-month is $12.99/mo.

vendors.provenance: 2026 USD pricing taken from Security.org's Mullvad pricing page (accessed 2026-06-13); Mullvad publishes a single flat rate (advertised in EUR, payable in USD).

plans.name: Mullvad VPN (flat monthly)
plans.notes: Single flat rate of $5.75/month (advertised as EUR 5) regardless of subscription length, with no tiers, no intro discounts, and no renewal hikes (price unchanged since 2009). Up to 5 simultaneous device connections, 14-day money-back guarantee (cash-by-mail and crypto payments non-refundable); 10% discount when paying by crypto.
